source_title: ACR Poker's $650K Halloween Mystery PKOs Enter Final Week Before Bounty Hunt
source_excerpt:
Three tournaments reach Day 2 on November 1, when mystery bounty action begins.
SAN JOSE, Costa Rica , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ACR Poker is in the final week of starting flights for three Halloween Special Mystery PKO tournaments carrying $650,000 in combined guarantees. All three reach Day 2 on Sunday, November 1, when eligible knockouts begin awarding mystery and progressive bounties.
The $109 tournament guarantees $500,000, the $33 event $100,000 and the $5.50 event $50,000. Daily Day 1 flights began October 18 and are scheduled to continue through November 1.
As of the morning of October 26, the events had recorded 1,117 Day 2 qualifiers, compared with 367 reported October 20. The latest count comprises 191 qualifiers in the $109 event, 171 in the $33 event and 755 in the $5.50 event. These are combined event counts, not unique players, and will change as flights continue.
ACR Pro Rob Kuhn has qualified for the $109 tournament, while Jeff Boski is through in both the $33 and $5.50 events. Players can combine qualifying chip stacks from multiple flights, subject to tournament rules.
Mystery PKO, a format exclusive to the Winning Poker Network, splits each revealed Mystery Bounty evenly: half is paid immediately to the eliminator and half is added to that player's visible Progressive Bounty. If an eliminated opponent already carries a Progressive Bounty, that amount is also split 50/50. No bounties are paid on Day 1, and all Day 2 entrants begin with $0 in accumulated Progressive Bounty.
For remaining flight information, qualification requirements and event rules, visit the official Halloween Special page . Participation and payouts are subject to applicable tournament conditions.
ACR Poker has been a leader in online poker since 2001, serving players across the U.S., Latin America, and beyond. The online poker site is renowned for massive tournament guarantees and innovative formats. ACR also has a rewarding loyalty ecosystem, including rakeback, reload bonuses, and leaderboard races.
